<thought>Based on the mapped reaction for template 1914395, the left‑hand side (reactant) of the reaction is the precursor. Removing atom‑mapping gives the SMILES of the alcohol precursor: O‑CH‑CH2‑N‑(CH2‑phenyl)‑CH2 forming a four‑membered ring, which can be written as "OCC1CCN(Cc2ccccc2)1". Therefore the list of possible precursors is a single combination containing this SMILES.</thought>
<final_answer>[['OCC1CCN(Cc2ccccc2)1']]</final_answer>
